title: agent-workflows loop contract (protocol 0.3)
description: Validates a `metadata.workflow` block that declares a loop contract: the exit-criteria conjunction, the iteration cap, stall detection, and scope binding (spec section 9.2). Sibling structures and unknown keys are tolerated per the 0.x degradation rules (spec section 9.5).

exit_criteria.description: A conjunction: every criterion must hold for the loop to exit (spec section 9.2).

max_iterations.description: Iteration cap; reaching it without exit escalates to the human (spec section 9.2).

stall.description: Detects spinning inside the cap; the declared action fires instead of burning remaining iterations (spec section 9.2).

signal.description: No meaningful output change between iterations (spec section 9.2).

action.description: Stop and hand the loop to the human (spec section 9.2).

scope.description: Binds the loop to the file scope its plan declared; drift signals feed mid-run reclassification (spec sections 5.3 and 9.2).

declared_from.description: The plan artifact whose file-scope section declares the allowed scope; a path carrying {P} resolves to one plan per phase and binds the loop to the union of what they declare (spec sections 8.1 and 9.2).

on_drift.description: flag records the signal; escalate stops for a human (spec section 9.2).

protocol.description: Protocol version this block was authored against, `<major>.<minor>` (spec sections 9 and 11).

artifact.description: Artifact that must exist and carry the required verdict (spec section 9.2).

verdict.description: The verdict the artifact must carry (spec section 3.3).
